slices.name: ws09-14-the-monthly-check
slices.brief: Checkpoint U, WS09 step 14: the monthly check. Pages: the confirm page, and one button for LCA admins. The email, its no-login link and the due rule, all in WS09's own files; the worker's one line is step 15. Behind CLUB_KEEPERS_ON. About fourteen files. 1. functions/utils/clubs/monthlyCheck.ts (new, package-free, plain SQL): runMonthlyCheck(env, now, force) finds each member holding an active regional seat that keeps at least one club, builds one email per person listing every club their seats keep, each with "Still accurate" (a signed link, purpose club_confirm, claim club id and member id, 30 days) and "Update" (the club's page in My region, after sign-in), and sends through sendEmailOutcome with one gate; at most ten sends a run, the rest on the next run. A timed call (force false) returns at once, before recordRun and before any query, when the constant is unset, the secret is missing or isCheckDue(now) is false, so the five-minute run writes no row and makes no query on the roughly 288 runs a day when nothing is due; only a real attempt runs inside recordRun as job club_monthly_check, with a mark per person and month in the run's detail. The timed run skips a person already sent this month's check at or after that first Monday's 8:00 AM, so each person gets it once on the first Monday. A forced call (the admin's button) ignores the due rule and the monthly mark: it sends to every representative each time it is pressed, is marked manual in the run's detail, and never counts as the timed send, so a press before the first Monday does not silence Monday's email; with the constant unset or the secret missing it sends nothing, writes no row and answers why in words. An open seat gets no email.
